question: In which year did Jawaharlal Nehru lay the foundation stone of the National Museum in New Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1955**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Jawaharlal Nehru laid the foundation stone of the **National Museum in New Delhi** on **May 12, 1955**.
 
• The National Museum was officially inaugurated later, on **December 18, 1960**, 
 
• It is **one of the largest museums in India,** housing a vast collection of artefacts from India's rich history, including archaeology, decorative arts, anthropology, and more.
 
• The concept for a national museum was first proposed in 1946, with an exhibition of Indian artefacts in London that showcased Indian art and heritage to the world.
 
• The success of that exhibition inspired the creation of a permanent museum in India to preserve and display its artefacts domestically.
 
• Its collection includes items from the **Indus Valley Civilization**, **Mauryan sculptures**, **Buddhist artefacts**, **Mughal miniatures**, and much more.
